First, it puts us in line. As we argued in [the key is not the risk](../../the-key-is-not-the-risk.md), a proxy in the middle isadds a singlecomponentpointthatofeveryfailure,call depends on, unless it is deployed redundantly, and it usually lacks the context to judge a request that looks valid; the state lives in the application. Second, the space is full: Drata, Sondera, AWS and the gateway makers all intercept tool calls already, and the customers we want already run some of them. Third, it is not what we are best at. As abp.sgit.ai puts it, a behaviour policy is "not a guardrail. It is what guardrails are compiled from."
